items.item_text: 01. I understand that all requested materials have been uploaded as attachments and are required for a complete application. This includes: 1.) Resume; 2.) A cover letter addressing the listed desirable qualifications, personal and professional qualities; 3.) A list of three (3) professional references including name, position, organization, phone number, email, and relationship to the applicant; 4.) Unofficial copies of all college transcripts; 5.) Response to the following question: What does it mean to have a commitment to diversity, and how would you apply this commitment as you conduct your responsibilities in this position? Options: Yes | No

Plans, organizes, coordinates and implements the psychomotor application component of the professional curricula to accomplish nursing program outcomes. Provide recommendations and implementations to increase the effectiveness of demonstrations and student educational experiences including the scheduling, planning and safe preparation of nursing laboratory and simulation scenarios while ordering organizing, maintaining and setting up necessary supplies, equipment and classroom layout.

In collaboration with the course faculty, supports instruction of students, individually and in group settings, with nursing practices, procedures and principles in the Nursing Skills/Simulation lab, and the clinical setting. Monitor student educational experiences and assure compliance with safety protocols and laboratory policies and procedures. Provide constructive student feedback for improved performance and competency during skills check-offs.

As a Clinical Teaching Assistant (CTA) in a clinical setting, maintains continuity of the learning environment by ensuing nursing students demonstrate accurate and best-practice psychomotor skills previously learned in the Skills/Simulation labs that reflect weekly student learning outcomes. Collaborates with all course instructors to provide constructive student feedback in the evaluation of the individual student’s clinical performance. Maintains and complies with professional clinical health records as required by the clinical facility. Supports, guides, and constructively critiques nursing students’ performance related to direct patient care at onsite clinical rotations including assisting students in the use of site computers and electronic medical records.

Collaborates with simulation faculty and support staff in planning, preparing and participating in educational scenarios to meet the course learning outcomes. Engage in the delivery of scenario during simulation including constructive feedback to aid in the individual student’s and group evaluation.

Orient and train skills lab assistant/student instructional aids in preparation, content and delivery of skills lab to meet the student learning outcomes in scheduled and open skills sessions. Collaborate with adjunct faculty, lab support staff, and clinical teaching assistance in the planning and teaching of small group lab scenarios in the Skills Lab to include proper lab operations, implementation of student performance, and completion of targeted skills of the course in the allotted scheduled time.

Provide tutoring assistance to students outside of classroom hours; schedule and implement open laboratory hours and coordinate tutoring sessions with faculty as required; Collaborates with the faculty and support staff to provide one-on-one remediation and tutoring to individual students who are on clinical contract, previously failed, return from temporary leave or recommended for skills review.

Coordinate and oversee the maintenance and operation of the Nursing Skills and Simulation laboratories; order, store and inventory supplies and equipment; organize and clean equipment, supplies and labs; assure the safe operation of testing equipment and troubleshoot problems; arrange for repair and replacement of damaged equipment with appropriate personnel as required; issue and retrieve loaner equipment and inspect for damage.

Generate, maintain and update Nursing Skills and Simulation Laboratory Coordinator manuals. Provide technical information and assistance to the Program Director of Nursing; assist in the formulation and development of policies, procedures and programs. Collaborate with nursing faculty and the Program Director of Nursing in the formulation and development of nursing psychomotor skills; assigned clinical activities; program policies and procedures.

Coordinate and plan the development of the annual preliminary budget Nursing Skills Lab budget; analyze and review budgetary and financial data; research, forecast, select and recommend products to assure accomplishment of program outcomes. Communicate with vendors for pricing and specifics associated with desired equipment and supplies. In collaboration with the Director of Nursing control and authorize expenditures in accordance with established limitations.

Serve on the Nursing Learning Resource Committee with nursing faculty members to determine learning and cost-effective additions, changes or surplus of supplies /equipment congruent with current clinical practice; draft minutes.
Demonstrate sensitivity to and respect for the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability and ethnic backgrounds of the College’s students, faculty, staff, and community.
Effectively engage and support historically disproportionately impacted groups by addressing issues of equity and improving culturally responsive service-oriented practices.
Assist nursing faculty with clinical onboarding, including managing health records and immunizations.
Attend department and division meetings as assigned.
Subject matters related to assigned labs.
Principles and theories of direct patient care.
Advanced nursing mathematical principles and scientific concepts.
Medical terminology.
Principles and practices of supervision and training.
Applicable laws, codes, regulations, policies and procedures.
Operation of a computer and assigned software.
Provide instruction to students, individually and in a group setting, relating to nursing practices, procedures and principles at an assigned College site.
Oversee and help modify nursing student performance relating to best-practice patient care standards at onsite clinical rotations.
Utilize lab apparatus including supplies and equipment used in acute care medical surgical settings.
Orient and train full and part-time faculty on use of new equipment and supplies.
Understand the safe mechanical function of and repair laboratory equipment.
Interpret, apply and explain rules, regulations, policies and procedures.
Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.
Analyze situations accurately and adopt an effective course of action.
Meet schedules and time lines.
Work independently with little direction.
Plan and organize work.
Maintain records and files.
Resume/Curriculum Vitae.
A cover letter addressing the listed desirable qualifications and personal/professional qualities.
A list of three (3) professional references including name, position, organization, phone number, email, and relationship to the applicant.

Techniques and principles of tutoring student assimilation of knowledge.
Effective oral and written communication skills.
Communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
Operate a computer and assigned office equipment.
